title: Activity
description: How busy this venue is against its own recent pace. A jump in activity often comes just before a move.

velocity_ratio.label: Pace vs baseline
velocity_ratio.description: Trades in the last ten seconds against the pace of the last half minute, as a change. Positive means busier than usual.

trades_10s.label: Trades in 10s
trades_10s.description: How many trades printed on this venue in the last ten seconds. The raw count behind the pace ratio.
